in_sanskrit.name: कुल्दीप्सिङ्ह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kuldipsinh is derived from the Sanskrit words कुल् (kul) meaning prosperity, दिप् (dip) meaning deep, and सिङ्ह (singh) meaning lion. The name signifies a powerful and prosperous lion.

in_hindi.name: कुल्दीप्सिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kuldipsinh in Hindi is derived from the words कुल् (kul) meaning prosperity, दिप् (dip) meaning deep, and सिंह (singh) meaning lion. The name signifies a powerful and prosperous lion.

in_tamil.name: குல்திப்பிஷிங்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kuldipsinh in Tamil is derived from the words குல் (kul) meaning prosperity, திப் (tip) meaning deep, பிஷி (pishan) meaning lion, and ங் (an) meaning male. The name signifies a powerful and prosperous lion.

in_telugu.name: కుల్దిప్పిశింహ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Kuldipsinh in Telugu is derived from the words కుల్ (kulam) meaning prosperity, దిప్ (dip) meaning deep, ప్పి (pippala) meaning lion, శింహ (singamu) meaning lion, and హ (h) meaning male. The name signifies a powerful and prosperous lion.

in_marathi.name: Kuldipsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon-born, crescent moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuldipsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'kula' meaning 'moon' and 'deep' meaning 'born'. The name Kuldipsinh signifies one who is born under the crescent moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of fertility, renewal, and protection.
